package.name: j10_mission
package.description: Mission state machine: IDLE -> PREFLIGHT -> ARMED -> TAKEOFF -> VLA_ACTIVE -> HOLD -> LAND -> DISARM. Owns the natural-language instruction and publishes the single autonomy_enabled permission that gates whether VLA output may reach the controller. Holds no flight-controller client and cannot raise a safety limit or clear an E-stop, so it cannot bypass the safety filter by construction rather than by convention.
